stem: Two lots with the same commercial cultivar name originate from different unverified sources. What is the strongest crop-planning response?
choices: Treat source identity as uncertain until provenance and retained-reference evidence support equivalence
Assume the names prove genetic identity
Merge the lots and discard source records
Use flower appearance as the only identity control
rationale: Commercial names do not establish germplasm identity. Crop planning should preserve source and identity records rather than assuming equivalence.
